lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gills are arranged in approximately five sub-parallel horizontal rows, forming a staggered grid-like distribution across the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary high-luminance blobs to create a series of high-contrast grid nodes across the lateral mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible above the gill slits, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (dorsal) to low-intensity shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small high-luminance spots, which are significantly more compact and less ordered than the lateral flank constellation.
